answer: Intermittent Proof-of-Idle Windows. Each identity must maintain a vault of pre-committed idle slots and answer randomized liveness pings during scheduled quiet intervals; an inlet buffers arrivals so burst-created identities miss their windows. Enforcement: identities whose response timing co-varies with a shared traffic spike are flagged and their slots revoked. The timber cost is real: each identity needs dedicated idle capacity plus scheduler overhead, so N sybils require N times the baseline idle resources.
